screens.title: Inventory
screens.description: A sparse item-slot fragment uses sculpted, blocky silhouettes and restrained shadow; equipment type remains readable by shape.

screens.title: Instruction Manual
screens.description: A standalone paper leaf combines page indexing, simple geometric diagrams, and original unreadable glyphs without borrowing book art.

screens.title: Island Map
screens.description: An oblique miniature terrain study uses stacked planes and a route marker; it is a map object, not a conventional dashboard panel.

limitations: The miniature terrain and paper manual are editorial design interpretations, not canonical TUNIC UI or a reconstruction of the game's page art.
All geometry, glyphs, item marks, landscape, and figures are original SVG studies. No official art or fonts are included.
The specimens show interface fragments only. Game state, item behavior, map navigation, engine integration, and independent use testing remain for later work.

componentCapture.scope: Parent-reviewed component rendering; independent full-screen usage follows.
